name: Podocyte (kidney filter cell)
short_description: Octopus-shaped epithelial cell that wraps its arms around the kidney's glomerular capillaries. A few thick major processes branch into thousands of interdigitating foot processes (pedicels), and the ~30–40 nm filtration slits between them — bridged by the nephrin slit diaphragm — form the finest layer of the blood filter. Post-mitotic: lost podocytes are never replaced.

reference: pass (Wikimedia Commons — 'Glomerulum of mouse kidney in Scanning Electron Microscope, magnification 5,000x.GIF', CC BY-SA 3.0, SecretDisc, own work. Viewed in-session: unmistakable podocyte architecture — capillary loops carpeted in interdigitating pedicel fans, bristled cell bodies, major processes fanning into parallel fingers with resolved filtration slits. Honest caveats: it is MOUSE kidney (equivalent architecture at this scale), greyscale/uncolorized, and the source carries a baked-in 'Glomerulum' caption plus a bottom instrument bar — real-02 removes both by a purely deterministic PIL crop (box 200,100,1055,955) followed by a 1.26x LANCZOS upscale to 1080 px; no AI edit was run, so nothing was re-illustrated. real-01 keeps the full plate for provenance)
coloring: pass after crop-and-retrace (gen-01 and gen-02 on flash were frameless but nearly centered — composed-page edge ink far below the good range; gen-03 with the zoomed brief drew the classic full frame, so per the skill the frame was cropped off deterministically (final box 75,29,935,946, square anchored to the bottom) and re-traced through coloring.py's own to_bitmap/trace_paths with no extra API call. Bottom is slightly under the 0.02 lower bound of the house 'good' range but the arm, tube and a water drop are genuinely cut by the bottom, left and right borders. EN and DE speech lines are vector text layers with a real em dash and real umlauts; no baked text in the artwork)
